capabilities: Open PNG, JPG and JPEG images in an embedded Photopea editor
Replace the default image viewer with the Photopea editor in the same panel
Edit images and manually export them back into the vault
disambiguation: Not a built-in image editor; it embeds the web-based Photopea service, and saving edits back into the vault is currently manual.
extras: Known issues: automated saving back to the vault is not supported yet (manual save and replace), and large images may perform poorly. Planned: automatic saving, more formats (GIF, SVG), custom Photopea scripts.
problem: Obsidian's default image viewer only displays images and offers no way to edit PNG or JPG files without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: integrates the powerful online image editor Photopea directly into Obsidian

summary: Embeds the Photopea online image editor in Obsidian, opening PNG and JPG images in it when clicked.
